summary: Flathead County, MT L-4 cab lookout: firelookout.com dates it 1931 with destruction in 1950; a 1930 newspaper report places a forestry student on it, so the dates conflict.

facts.status_note: firelookout.com says the cab was destroyed in 1950; no source describes the site today

events.note: Forestry student Kendall Rutherford reported stationed on Doris lookout in a Daily Inter Lake item dated August 4, 1930; the same item reports he drowned while swimming in an unnamed South Fork district lake the afternoon before it ran

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com dates the L-4 cab to 1931, but the August 4, 1930 Daily Inter Lake report, reprinted on the Forest Lookouts Montana page, places a forestry student on the lookout the year before. The sources read do not reconcile the two dates, so the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Three sources only. The 1930 staffing report and the 1931 build date conflict and the story says so. No photos found. No public-access information found, so the story points readers to the Flathead National Forest. Brief record had no conflicts to correct.
